description:
This superb three-bedroom brick-fronted townhouse is ideally situated within the popular and well-established Deravarra development, conveniently positioned between Mullingar town centre and the M4 motorway. Presented in excellent condition throughout and benefiting from a substantial programme of energy-efficiency upgrades completed in 2025, including new windows and doors, additional insulation, a new boiler and an A3 BER rating, this impressive home is ready for immediate occupation.

The accommodation opens with a spacious entrance hall finished with tiled flooring giving access to the living room that is bright and finished with laminate flooring and featuring a solid fuel open fireplace. To the rear, the generous kitchen and dining area is fitted offering ample storage and worktop space. A convenient guest WC completes the ground-floor accommodation.

Upstairs, the landing comes with laminate flooring and provides Stira access to the attic, which is partially floored for additional storage. There are three well-proportioned bedrooms, two of which are spacious doubles with fitted wardrobes. The primary bedroom also comes en-suite, while a family bathroom with bath serves the remaining accommodation.

The property has undergone a number of significant improvements during 2025. These include a new oil tank and boiler, new windows and doors, additional insulation with 87mm insulated slab, a solar panel for water heating and a new water tank. These upgrades have contributed to the property's impressive A3 BER rating.

Externally, the property enjoys an attractive south-west-facing rear garden with a covered patio area and a timber garden shed. Gated side access leads to the rear, while a cobblelock driveway provides off-street parking to the front.

Deravarra is a popular residential development with an exceptionally convenient position on the Dublin Road side of Mullingar. Lakepoint Business Park and Mullingar Omniplex are nearby, while Mullingar town centre offers an extensive selection of amenites and schools. Easy access to the M4.

Ideal for first-time buyers and families seeking an energy-efficient home requiring no work. Viewing is highly recommended.
